items.title_kr: Kohl's, Uber Eats와 Partnership 체결해 nationwide on-demand retail delivery 시작
items.title_en: Kohl's Partners With Uber Eats for Nationwide Retail Delivery
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Uber Eats와의 Partnership을 통해 미국 전역에서 on-demand merchandise delivery 서비스를 런칭했습니다. Holiday season을 앞두고 빠르고 편리한 fulfillment channel을 확보하여 추가 traffic과 sell-through를 견인할 전망입니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's launched nationwide on-demand merchandise delivery through a partnership with Uber Eats. This fulfillment channel aims to capture incremental traffic and boost sell-through ahead of the holiday season.

items.title_kr: Hollister, Highcross에 Leicestershire 첫 offline store 오픈
items.title_en: Hollister opens first store in Leicestershire at Highcross
items.body_kr: Hollister opened its first offline store in Leicestershire at the Highcross shopping center. This expansion strengthens its retail footprint and targets teen consumers for holiday merchandise sales.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Q3 earnings 발표 앞두고 주가 상승세 및 실적 기대감 고조
items.title_en: Macy's Stock Gains Attention Ahead Of Earnings Beat Test
items.body_kr: Macy's stock gained attention ahead of its Q3 earnings release. Early holiday promotion performance and merchandise inventory efficiency will be key factors in meeting market expectations.

items.title_kr: Off-price retailer TJX, 견조한 holiday demand 힘입어 연간 guidance 상향 조정
items.title_en: Off-price retailer TJX lifts annual forecast on strong holiday demand, shares jump
items.body_kr: TJX lifted its annual forecast and saw shares jump, driven by strong holiday consumer demand. This robust preference for off-price retail channels signals positive reorder potential for vendor partners.
